description: Source code for the 'game' class in the Wesnoth project, managing game state, players, turns, and communication.

classes.name: game
classes.description: Class managing the game state, players, turns, and communication in Wesnoth.

methods.name: game
methods.description: Constructor initializing game with player info.

methods.name: is_owner
methods.description: Checks if a connection is the owner (first player).

methods.name: is_member
methods.description: Checks if a connection is a member of the game.

methods.name: is_needed
methods.description: Checks if a connection is needed (first in queue).

methods.name: is_observer
methods.description: Checks if a connection is an observer.

methods.name: observers_can_label
methods.description: Returns false, observers cannot label commands.

methods.name: observers_can_chat
methods.description: Returns true, observers can chat.

methods.name: filter_commands
methods.description: Filters commands for observers based on permissions.

methods.name: start_game
methods.description: Starts the game, sets up sides, and notifies players.

methods.name: take_side
methods.description: Allows a player to take a side in the game.

methods.name: update_side_data
methods.description: Updates internal data about sides and controllers.

methods.name: transfer_side_control
methods.description: Transfers control of a side to another player.

methods.name: available_slots
methods.description: Returns the number of available slots for players.

methods.name: describe_slots
methods.description: Updates description with current slot info.

methods.name: player_is_banned
methods.description: Checks if a player is banned.

methods.name: ban_player
methods.description: Bans a player and removes them.

methods.name: process_commands
methods.description: Processes commands issued in the game.

methods.name: end_turn
methods.description: Ends the current turn, updates turn count.

methods.name: add_player
methods.description: Adds a new player or observer to the game.

methods.name: remove_player
methods.description: Removes a player or observer from the game.

methods.name: send_user_list
methods.description: Sends the list of users to all players.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the game ID.

methods.name: send_data
methods.description: Sends data to all players, optionally excluding one.

methods.name: player_on_team
methods.description: Checks if a player is on a specific team.

methods.name: send_data_team
methods.description: Sends data to all players on a team.

methods.name: send_data_observers
methods.description: Sends data to all observers.

methods.name: record_data
methods.description: Records game data into history.

methods.name: reset_history
methods.description: Clears game history.

methods.name: level_init
methods.description: Checks if level is initialized.

methods.name: level
methods.description: Returns reference to level configuration.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if there are no players.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects all players.

methods.name: set_description
methods.description: Sets the game description.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the game description.

methods.name: add_players
methods.description: Adds players from another game instance.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Returns whether the game has started.
